summary: View operator logs by finding the pod (oc get pods | grep operator) and running oc logs -f, or directly with oc logs deployments/automation-controller-operator-controller-manager -c automation-controller-manager -f.
questions: How do I view the automation controller operator logs?
oc logs for the AAP operator

answer_card.title: Operator logs
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc get pods | grep operator
oc logs <operator-pod-name> -f
# or
oc logs deployments/automation-controller-operator-controller-manager -c automation-controller-manager -f
```
